description: This file defines an interface for Orleans grains, specifically IMultifacetReader, which extends IGrainWithIntegerKey and provides a method GetValue to asynchronously retrieve an integer.

classes.name: IMultifacetReader
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface that extends IGrainWithIntegerKey, providing a GetValue method to asynchronously fetch an integer value.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: An asynchronous method returning a Task of int, used to obtain a value from the grain.
